notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for a terminal timestamped ordinary object deletion and named object-instance reuse. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies name reservation, terminal retraction, tombstone reclamation, named re-registration, and standard lifecycle cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped DeleteObjectInstance, object-instance name reservation and registration, Retract, lookup, and federation lifecycle declarations with FederateAmbassador reservation, time-role, and grant callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador timestamped object-deletion, object-name, retraction, lookup, and lifecycle declarations and FederateAmbassador callbacks
